About the Community Awareness event

Community Awareness is a Teamwork event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: speech & presentation · online submission.

Ten in-depth lessons for the HOSA Community Awareness team event: a local health or safety campaign (July 1, 2026 – May 15, 2027) documented in a pre-judged portfolio of up to 12 pages (80 points) and presented to judges in five minutes with notecards only. Covers choosing a topic in physical, mental, environmental or societal health, research and needs assessment, SMART goals and logic models, community partnerships, campaign activities and original items, publicity, measuring impact, the portfolio, the presentation and sustaining the campaign. Includes domain sorting, planning drills, calculation examples, rubric checklists and campaign scenarios.

Community Awareness lessons

The event, health domains and research.

Unit 2 · Planning and partnerships

Goals, objectives, logic models and community partners.

Unit 3 · Running the campaign

Activities and original items, publicity and measuring impact.

    A table with a stack of pamphlets attracts few people. A booth with a blood pressure demonstration, a myth-or-fact spinning wheel and a QR code to a student-made video draws a crowd. Judges score original, high-quality…

Round One portfolio, Round Two presentation, delivery and sustainability.
